title: performance(canary): improved auto-detection and rollout guards for latency/throughput regressions
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: reduce noisy canary rollouts and prevent customer-facing regressions by improving automated detection sensitivity and adding conservative rollout guards. This PR updates the performance canary detector to be workload-aware (latency + throughput), adds hysteresis on regression detection to avoid flapping, and wires a rollout guard into the routing layer so canaries auto-roll back when sustained regressions are detected.

What changed: updated detector logic, new configuration knobs for per-model thresholds and hysteresis, canary metrics instrumentation, integration with rollout guard service, and end-to-end tests.

Checklist: 
- [x] Implement adaptive detection algorithm (latency + throughput)
- [x] Add hysteresis and minimum evaluation window to avoid noisy flips
- [x] Instrument canary metrics (p50/p95 latency, rps, error-rate) with tags for model/version/pool
- [x] Add rollout guard that triggers safe rollback and throttled traffic shifting
- [x] Add unit and integration tests
- [x] Update docs and runbook

Notes: This builds on prior canary work (ENG-1873) by extending thresholds to include throughput deltas and by making the detector cache-aware so KV cache pressure doesn't get mis-classified as regression. The default policy is conservative: short-lived spikes will not trigger rollbacks; detection requires sustained deviation for the configured window.

Risk: Medium. Changes are behind feature flag perf_canary_v2 and default to existing behavior unless enabled. Rollout guard is designed to fail-safe (automatically revert to previous routing if CI or metric collector fails).

How to test locally: run tests in tests/perf and start the local perf-canary service with --feature-flag perf_canary_v2. The CI job "perf-canary-integration" validates detector behavior against recorded workloads.

release_notes: Improved performance canary detection: adaptive latency+throughput detection, hysteresis to prevent flapping, and rollout guards to automatically revert canaries on sustained regressions. Behind feature flag perf_canary_v2.
testing_instructions: Run `pytest tests/perf` and start local canary with `./bin/perf-canary --feature-flag perf_canary_v2`. Use recorded workload in tests/fixtures/recordings to validate detection behavior.
notes: This PR should reduce noisy canary rollbacks in infra-heavy workloads by making decisions workload-aware and resilient to KV cache pressure. Will monitor canary dashboards closely after rollout.
